scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with exact univariate Sturm root count; numerical values and simulation are ancillary. The probability formula and unrefined right-tetrahedron extremum are prior results, not new claims.
scientific_limitations: Trirectangular tetrahedra only; exact Haar-uniform viewing distribution, not finitely sampled inference. The accessible 2015 nonobtuse-simplex comparator was abstract-only. Independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp symmetry-breaking stability for random shadows of right tetrahedra
